tools.name: coi_analyze
tools.description: Extract PDF/image fields with confidence, then compare them with contract requirements. Uncertain OCR is WARN and is never treated as verified. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/coi/analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: coi_coverage-grade
tools.description: Compare a caller-supplied certificate of insurance, as text or JSON, with the minimum limits, endorsements, and expiry date in the request. The grade is the share of each minimum that is missing. The text is not a PDF and the result is not a coverage opinion. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/coi/cover
